# Fumadocs

Docs built with Fumadocs (`fumadocs-core`, `fumadocs-ui`, `fumadocs-mdx`) on Next.js, React Router, TanStack Start, Waku or Astro. Reference: https://fumadocs.dev/docs/page-conventions and https://fumadocs.dev/docs/markdown.

## Detect

- `package.json` has `fumadocs-core`, `fumadocs-ui` or `fumadocs-mdx`.
- `source.config.ts`, or `defineDocs` from `fumadocs-mdx/macro` in `lib/source.ts`, plus a `loader({ baseUrl, source })` call.
- `meta.json` files inside the content folder (default `content/docs/`).
- Live site: Tailwind classes prefixed `fd-` (`text-fd-primary`, `fd-steps`) and Next.js `/_next/` assets when hosted on Next.

The dependency wins. `meta.json` alone is not proof.

## Get the source

### From the repo

Content folder = `dir` in `defineDocs(...)`. Read alongside it:

- `lib/source.ts`: `baseUrl`, the `icon()` handler, `i18n`, loader `plugins` (they can rewrite slugs or the tree).
- `lib/layout.shared.tsx` (older: `app/layout.config.tsx`): `nav.title`, `links`, `githubUrl`.
- `components/mdx.tsx` (older: `mdx-components.tsx`): components usable in MDX without an import. List them before converting.
- `source.config.ts` `mdxOptions`: remark/rehype plugins that change syntax (`remarkSteps`, `remarkMdxFiles`, `remarkDirectiveAdmonition`, math).

If content comes from a CMS integration (Notion, Sanity) the repo has no MDX; use the live site.

### From an export

None; the site is built from the repo.

### From the live site

If the site enabled the LLM integration (https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/llms), fetch `/llms.txt` for the page list and `<page-url>.md` per page; components appear as JSX. Otherwise mirror the rendered `<article>`.

## Config → docs.json

| Fumadocs                                          | docs.json                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `nav.title` (text or JSX)                         | `name`; image inside it → `logo`                                |
| `githubUrl`                                       | `navbar.links` entry with `type: "github"`                      |
| `links` (`text`, `url`, `icon`)                   | `navbar.links`, or `navigation.tabs` with `href` if in main row |
| `<Banner>` in a layout                            | `banner`                                                        |
| Root folders (`root: true`)                       | `navigation.tabs`                                               |
| Root folders sharing a type (`root: "version"`)   | `navigation.versions` if versions are migrated, else report     |
| `i18n` (`defineI18n`)                             | `navigation.languages` if languages are migrated, else report   |
| `icon()` handler built on `lucide-react`          | `icons.library: "lucide"`                                       |
| `loader({ baseUrl })`                             | none; affects URLs, see below                                   |
| Search provider (Orama, Algolia, Mixedbread, ...) | drop and report                                                 |
| Feedback, Open Graph image routes, page actions   | drop and report                                                 |
| Theme CSS / presets                               | `colors.primary` from the rendered CSS; rest drop and report    |

## Navigation

Each folder's `meta.json` is the nav source. Resolve every folder, then emit groups in that order:

| `meta.json`                               | Mintlify                                                                    |
| ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| folder `title`                            | `group` label (fallback: the folder name as Fumadocs renders it)            |
| `pages` list                              | `pages` in that order; with no `...`, unlisted items are not in the sidebar |
| no `pages`                                | items sorted alphabetically                                                 |
| `"..."` / `"z...a"`                       | expand to the remaining items, alphabetical / reversed                      |
| `"!item"`                                 | remove `item` from the expanded rest                                        |
| `"...folder"`                             | inline that folder's items here, no nested group                            |
| `"---Label---"`, `"---[Icon]Label---"`    | close the current group; following items form a new group `Label`           |
| `"[Text](url)"`, `"external:[Text](url)"` | a page with frontmatter `title` + `url: <href>`, listed at that position    |
| `index.mdx` or `pagesIndex`               | group `root`                                                                |
| `defaultOpen: true`                       | `expanded: true` on the nested group                                        |
| `collapsible: false`                      | report                                                                      |
| `icon`                                    | `icon`, converted (below)                                                   |
| `root: true` + `title`, `description`     | tab label; `description` only if you use `navigation.products`              |
| `meta.<lang>.json`                        | that language's labels                                                      |

Folders in parentheses, `(name)/`, group files without adding a URL segment. Move their files up one level and keep the nav their `meta.json` defines.

Icons are names resolved by the repo's own `icon()` handler, usually PascalCase `lucide-react` exports. Convert each to its lucide.dev kebab-case name (`BookOpen` → `book-open`; strip a trailing `Icon`) and confirm it exists on lucide.dev. Drop icons you cannot confirm.

## Content conversion

| Fumadocs                                                           | Mintlify                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `<Callout>` / `type="info"`                                        | `<Info>`                                                             |
| `type="warn"` / `"warning"`                                        | `<Warning>`                                                          |
| `type="error"`                                                     | `<Danger>`                                                           |
| `type="success"`                                                   | `<Check>`                                                            |
| `type="idea"`                                                      | `<Tip>`                                                              |
| Callout `title`                                                    | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components)                      |
| `:::tip[Title]` etc. (remarkDirectiveAdmonition enabled)           | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Admonitions)                     |
| `<Cards>` / `<Card icon={<X />} title href>`                       | `<Columns cols={2}>` / `<Card icon="x" title href>`                  |
| `<Tabs items={[...]}>` + `<Tab value="A">`                         | `<Tabs>` + `<Tab title="A">`; no `value` → label from `items[i]`     |
| `<Tabs defaultIndex>`; `groupId`, `persist`, `updateAnchor`        | `defaultTabIndex`; drop the rest                                     |
| `<Accordions>` / `<Accordion title id>`                            | `<AccordionGroup>` / `<Accordion title id>`                          |
| `<Steps><Step>### Title ...</Step></Steps>`                        | `<Steps><Step title="Title">...</Step></Steps>`, heading removed     |
| `### Title [step]`, `### 1. Title` (remark-steps), `fd-steps` divs | `<Steps>` / `<Step title>`                                           |
| `<Files>` / `<Folder name defaultOpen>` / `<File name>`            | `<Tree>` / `<Tree.Folder name defaultOpen>` / `<Tree.File name>`     |
| ` ```files ` fence (remark-mdx-files)                              | `<Tree>`                                                             |
| `<TypeTable type={{ key: { type, default, description } }}>`       | one `<ResponseField name type default>` per key, description as body |
| `<include>./x.mdx</include>`                                       | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content)                |
| `<include>./code.ts#region</include>`                              | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Code imports)                    |
| `<Mermaid chart="...">` (user component)                           | ` ```mermaid ` fence                                                 |
| `## Heading [#custom-id]`                                          | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Heading IDs)                     |
| `## Heading [!toc]` / `[toc]`                                      | strip the marker; report                                             |

Code fences:

| Fumadocs meta                                     | Mintlify                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `title="x"`                                       | `title="x"`                                               |
| `lineNumbers`                                     | `lines`                                                   |
| `lineNumbers=N`                                   | `lines`; report the start offset                          |
| adjacent fences with `tab="A"`                    | one `<CodeGroup>`, each block titled `A`                  |
| `tab-group="..."`                                 | drop                                                      |
| `// [!code highlight]` / `[!code focus]` comments | remove; `highlight={n}` / `focus={n}`                     |
| `// [!code ++]` / `[!code --]`                    | keep                                                      |
| `// [!code word:x]`                               | remove; report                                            |
| `twoslash`                                        | keep                                                      |
| ` ```npm ` fence                                  | (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Package-manager tabs) |

Imports: remove `fumadocs-ui/*`, `fumadocs-core/*` and `lucide-react` imports after converting their usages (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components).

Frontmatter: keep `title`, `description` (Fumadocs UI renders it under the title), `icon` (converted). `full: true` → `mode: "wide"`, report. Pages with `_openapi` frontmatter that render `<OpenAPIPage>`/`<APIPage>` are generated; delete them and follow `mint migrate --topic api`.

## Assets

`public/` is served from the site root: `public/img/a.png` → `/img/a.png` (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files). Images imported into MDX (`import img from './a.png'`) or referenced relatively: move the file and use its root path.

## URLs and redirects

URL = `baseUrl` + file path slugs: `dir/page.mdx` → `<baseUrl>/dir/page`, `dir/index.mdx` → `<baseUrl>/dir`, `(group)` segments dropped. With i18n, locales prefix the path unless `hideLocale` hides it (`default-locale`: default locale unprefixed; `always`: no prefix). Loader plugins may change slugs; trust the live sitemap over the file tree.

If the Mintlify site drops the `baseUrl` prefix, add a base path redirect (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Redirects).

## Known gaps

Report these:

- `[!toc]` / `[toc]` heading markers, `<InlineTOC>` and page-tree-driven card lists (render the list statically).
- `<auto-type-table>`, `<auto-files>`: generated at build time; render their output statically.
- `<DynamicCodeBlock>`, `<GithubInfo>`, `<ImageZoom>`, `<GraphView>`.
- Custom Shiki transformers, `[!code word:]`, line number offsets, persisted tab groups.
- `collapsible: false` folders and nested `[Text](url)` sidebar links.
- GraphQL and AsyncAPI pages generated by Fumadocs integrations.
